Codex review: needs real behavior proof before merge. ## What this changes This PR batches auth reads, moves outbox SQL into its worker, and reuses prepared session, sandbox, and worktree facts. **Example:** Agent preparation reads both persisted auth rows. - **Before:** Credential and runtime-state cells require two statements. - **After:** Both cells are read in one statement. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | Useful direction, but the reservation regression is confirmed and the changed authority boundary lacks successful final-effect evidence; no schema or serialized-format migration is introduced. | | **Proof confidence** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | Real behavior proof is necessary before merge. See [Before merge](#before-merge). | | **Patch quality** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | Security review found an item that needs attention. | ## Product **Kind:** Performance · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Agent preparation performs redundant database work and retains avoidable host-thread SQL. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored direction has clear value and uses existing owners; the recorded replay and renewal tradeoffs do not require another product decision. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Blocked before merge - 6 items remain** Keep this PR open for its useful performance work, but block merge on the remaining reservation regression. Exact-head CI confirms the previously reported hydration defect; the relay test-ratchet finding is fixed. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `0aedb5671c69b2ab1a755784e210ae42fa73cd07` ## Before merge - [ ] **Add real behavior proof** - Authority-chain proof required: Exercise the changed sandbox facts owner through final command launch or workspace I/O with a valid persisted generation after restart, then removed or reassigned generations, supported native mutations, and unknown settlement. The complete body and discussion provide a relay unit-test result and pending validation, without this after-fix trace. Supply redacted logs, live output, or a recording, removing IPs, API keys, phone numbers, and non-public endpoints. After adding proof, update the PR body; ClawSweeper should re-review automatically. If it does not, the PR author or someone with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review`. - [ ] **Preserve hydration on empty reservation settlement receipts (P1)** - This previous finding remains unresolved. After restart or database reopen, reserving an existing pending or ready runtime can return its row without writing anything. The worker publishes an empty successful settlement receipt, but this subscriber still increments facts.revision. The installer captured before reserveSandboxRegistryEntry then skips the returned row because the revision changed, leaving no cached generation. createSandboxBackend rejects the valid reservation as removed before calling its provider. Exact-head CI confirms both retained-ID reopen cases fail through this path. Do not advance the revision for empty successful receipts, or publish the returned authoritative reservation fact while preserving replacement and unknown-settlement invalidation. - [ ] **Resolve security concern: Establish complete final-effect invalidation coverage** - The new guard consumes process-local facts instead of reading the authoritative row. Typed mutation publications are present, but the prior boundary explicitly retained native reads for incomplete receipt coverage. Establish rejection of a removed or reassigned generation before provider launch or workspace I/O, including supported native mutations and unknown settlement. - [ ] **Resolve merge risk** - Before merge, establish that supported native and worker registry mutations invalidate removed or reassigned sandbox authority before command launch or workspace I/O; the replaced guard explicitly retained a native read for incomplete receipt coverage. - [ ] **Complete next step** - Resolve GitHub's reported merge conflict and investigate the built-CLI lifecycle failure, fixing any patch-caused defect or establishing its external cause. - [ ] **Improve patch quality** - Prove valid-generation execution and rejection of removed or reassigned generations before final I/O, including supported native mutations and unknown settlement. ## Findings - [P1] Preserve hydration on empty reservation settlement receipts — `src/agents/sandbox/registry-currentness.ts:38-39` - [high] Establish complete final-effect invalidation coverage — `src/agents/sandbox/registry-currentness.ts:79` ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: Show successful sandbox reuse after restart and rejection of removed or reassigned generations before final command launch or workspace I/O through the changed owner.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Agent preparation consumes admitted session and database state, uses SQLite workers for persistence, and supplies model ownership and sandbox authority to execution. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Agent preparation] --> B[Admitted session facts] A --> C[SQLite worker operations] C --> D[Agent and shared databases] D --> E[Committed registry facts] B --> F[Model and sandbox effects] E --> F ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep the worker cutover while allowing unchanged persisted reservations to hydrate without weakening replacement or unknown-settlement rejection. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current-main source shows repeated preparation reads, and exact-head CI independently confirms the introduced reservation hydration failure; no target code was run during this review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The existing workers and publication owners are appropriate places for these reductions, but the facts guard must preserve cold reservation hydration and current authority at final effects. Full review comments: - [P1] Preserve hydration on empty reservation settlement receipts — `src/agents/sandbox/registry-currentness.ts:38-39` This previous finding remains unresolved. After restart or database reopen, reserving an existing pending or ready runtime can return its row without writing anything. The worker publishes an empty successful settlement receipt, but this subscriber still increments facts.revision. The installer captured before reserveSandboxRegistryEntry then skips the returned row because the revision changed, leaving no cached generation. createSandboxBackend rejects the valid reservation as removed before calling its provider. Exact-head CI confirms both retained-ID reopen cases fail through this path. Do not advance the revision for empty successful receipts, or publish the returned authoritative reservation fact while preserving replacement and unknown-settlement invalidation. Confidence: 1 Overall correctness: patch is incorrect Overall confidence: 0.97 AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [1598547552d6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1598547552d6fa9f7955c9de3ab785f40c8cf679). ### Merge-risk options **Maintainer options:** 1. **Complete the receipt guard cutover (recommended)** Repair empty-receipt hydration and demonstrate that valid persisted generations work while removed or reassigned generations cannot reach final effects. 2. **Retain the existing final guard** Keep the native final registry read temporarily and land the independent auth, relay, outbox, and preparation reductions. ### Provenance checked - `Sandbox effect guards` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (83ce1401d658f4c723063a9900ba5af9bcbb5adb: Final native generation reads protected retained sandbox callbacks while receipt coverage remained incomplete; https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168025 subsequently added typed publications without retiring those guards.) - `Outbox worker placement and recovery` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/158209: Worker execution avoided a host-thread SQLite busy wait that stalled replies; this PR retains that owner and the existing idempotent logical-turn contract.) - `Relay ownership mutations` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/149397: Publication and renewal validated the live registration, while pruning compared complete snapshots; guarded SQL retains ownership checks and the body accepts same-owner timestamp supersession.) - `Auth-row reader` keeps the original intent (d3d2d2ea3b47eae541232eb5528d23d3276e2518: Runtime auth rows used admitted read ownership and cache invalidation; batching preserves independent cell classification and existing malformed-legacy handling.) - `Native model preparation` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (00daeebaf390ac9144c567ca399dd8a3707dc1ee: Preparation and dispatch were bound to current session ownership; the admitted entry replaces the initial reread while dispatch still refreshes ownership.) - `Subagent cancellation preparation` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/163485: Cancellation reused ready session generations to avoid unrelated writer stalls; this PR retains the session-generation owner and removes an additional preparation writer.) - `Worktree lease census` keeps the original intent (06cbb349bae43dc23afe949270e03fb86e67a663: Cleanup read leases without the state write lock; the complete worker census now supplies the lookup while destructive removal keeps its authoritative lock checks.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security Needs attention: The sandbox authority cutover needs final-effect validation; inspection found no concrete authorization bypass or supply-chain regression. ### Evidence Security concerns: - [high] Establish complete final-effect invalidation coverage — `src/agents/sandbox/registry-currentness.ts:79` The new guard consumes process-local facts instead of reading the authoritative row. Typed mutation publications are present, but the prior boundary explicitly retained native reads for incomplete receipt coverage. Establish rejection of a removed or reassigned generation before provider launch or workspace I/O, including supported native mutations and unknown settlement. Confidence: 0.93 What I checked: - **Pinned introduction:** Reviewed the introduced changes from 6e06137f85ef3262f47dae63626d97f14c2f1ca1 to 0aedb5671c69b2ab1a755784e210ae42fa73cd07; current main still retains the native sandbox generation read and the older outbox preparation path. ([`src/agents/sandbox/registry.ts:182`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/0aedb5671c69b2ab1a755784e210ae42fa73cd07/src/agents/sandbox/registry.ts#L182), [0aedb5671c69](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0aedb5671c69b2ab1a755784e210ae42fa73cd07)) - **Confirmed reservation failure:** The exact-head CI annotations show both database-reopen reservation cases failing at runtime-reservation.test.ts:430 through registry-currentness.ts:86.
